named_scope_store_evidence.label: ed-multipart-sign
named_scope_store_evidence.named_scope: Production nonce r and key_term owners
named_scope_store_evidence.basis: Nonce from_hash result is copied into rsp+0x20..0x3f; key_term multiplication result is moved to rsp+0..0x1f. Both exact 32-byte current owner slots receive immediate-zero stores before return.

unwind_call.basis: Selected signer contains cleanup calls attributed to SecretScalar::drop at signing.rs:941 on unwind; actual generic error/unwind execution is separately covered by unit witnesses.

source_zeroize_basis.semantics: Slice Zeroize calls volatile_set; volatile_set uses ptr::write_volatile per byte. The observed stores remain in the optimized binary.

limits: This establishes selected current named-slot cleanup writes, not all copies, all paths or all registers.
Actual target is local x86_64; no new OCI ARM/WSL execution is inferred.
Long-key HMAC, every Simple/Reset variant, optional kdf and all prehash paths are not individually covered by this selected linked assembly set.
Source/functional witnesses cover more cases than this selected assembly review; neither substitutes for the other.
Scalar backend limbs/radix digits, argument copies, historical moves, unused SigningKey::to_scalar_bytes conversion path, OS/provider copies and process abort remain outside the guarantee.
